title: Knight Was the Glue
setup: Your rook eyes the bishop on b4, and the knight on d5 is the only black piece defending it.
hint: Your rook already attacks a defended piece. Look one square farther along: who is doing the defending?
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Bxd5}} removes the knight that guards b4. After {{cxd5}} the bishop has nobody left and {{Rxb4}} wins it. Bishop for knight is an even trade; the bishop on b4 is the profit. Always ask who is holding the piece you want before you reach for it.
